items.title: Percy Gabriel Interview, 1987-07-10
items.q: I think it was Paul Gaten had me to come out on this session.

ctx.x: But you said they were a bunch of wild kids.

Yes, but I mean they just asked me to come out and record. And I think it was Paul Gaten had me to come out on this session. But these kids, you know some of those kids he had playing with them, but Roy didn't even know what key that was playing in.
I'm not kidding. So there was something substandard?
